narrative: The short greeting stands, unstruck. Under it a fresh run. A count in the margin. The tables at the edge of the board still show the three words. The three words, still three, at the edge of the board. The pen is set down on the new run.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the thirty lines and left the three words on the tables.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Thirty lines under the greeting
